mapper.insert: insert into system_admin_team_members( owner_user_id, member_user_id, added_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) values (#{ownerUserId}, #{memberUserId}, #{addedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, null) on conflict (owner_user_id, member_user_id) do update set added_by_user_id = excluded.added_by_user_id, updated_at = excluded.updated_at, deleted_at = null

merge into system_admin_team_members as target using (values (#{ownerUserId}, #{memberUserId}, #{addedByUserId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})) as incoming(owner_user_id, member_user_id, added_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at) on target.owner_user_id = incoming.owner_user_id and target.member_user_id = incoming.member_user_id when matched then update set added_by_user_id = incoming.added_by_user_id, updated_at = incoming.updated_at, deleted_at = null when not matched then insert(owner_user_id, member_user_id, added_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) values(incoming.owner_user_id, incoming.member_user_id, incoming.added_by_user_id, incoming.created_at, incoming.updated_at, null)
